name: Circle Splat Rendering
definition: A rendering technique where voxels are projected as 2D quads (splats) in screen space, using a fixed offset to determine the quad size based on the splat size parameter and grid scale.
summary: Circle Splat Rendering projects volumetric primitives as 2D quads to leverage hardware rasterization, differing from point-splatting by using configurable quad geometry for consistent coverage and efficient frustum culling.
